conventions.arr_growth: current ARR / previous quarter ARR - 1; both selected using the same knowledge cutoff
conventions.cap_history: common shares and each class's fund holdings are assumed static; no fund common holdings supplied
conventions.currency: USD assumed; all source monetary amounts are whole-dollar units, not thousands
conventions.equity_value: enterprise value + net_cash; net_cash defaults to zero and may only change in a hypothetical scenario
conventions.historical_check: ordinary marks fail on a mismatch at the publication-date cutoff; later recalculations and explicitly overridden company marks disclose differences
conventions.incomplete: missing current ARR/multiple yields no mark; malformed or conflicting inputs and calculation failures remain fatal
conventions.knowledge_cutoff: inclusive date; omitted cutoff means latest supplied records, never wall-clock time
conventions.mark_change: rounded current fund mark / published prior-quarter dollars - 1
conventions.missing_baseline: missing or zero denominator produces null percentage with a reason
conventions.ownership: fund preferred shares / (common including option pool + active preferred shares)
conventions.preference_effect: flag fund waterfall value differing from pro-rata equity value by at least one dollar
conventions.prior_mark: latest eligible published prior-quarter mark, never a recomputed valuation
conventions.prior_recalculation: recalculate prior quarter with the same cutoff and its quarter-end cap, without current overrides; retain published comparison baseline
conventions.quarter_end: calendar quarter-end; preferred issue_date must be on or before it
conventions.review_policy: calculate supplied values; flag ARR changes of at least 50%, declines and revisions; never infer corrections
conventions.rounding: Decimal precision 60; ROUND_HALF_UP to whole dollars only after summing fund contributions
conventions.scenarios: explicit overrides are hypothetical; original source observations and published marks are retained
